dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: Life's only exciting when you're among the treasure hunters. And here's the thing — you can't live life without a little spice!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like you're living a cozy life.

dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: Cozy? More like boooo-ring! But I guess if being comfortable counts as being happy... Ah well. What matters is that I'm not living the life I want to right now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Being an adventurer is more than exciting enough. See ya...

dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm just grousing to myself. Nothing directed at you. Still, what a luxury it must be to live so enviably... Safe travels, my friend!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sometimes I think that way too.

dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: Haha, you're in the right place, then! This is where treasure hunters gather. You'll never find a place with more interesting experiences amongst its clientele.

dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: Of course, if you want to say bye-bye to a boring life, the only way is to become a treasure hunter!

dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I had an in of some kind...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Afraid I've never thought that way.

dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: Lucky you! You found the life you wanted at such a young age... Ah well, it is what it is. World's as wide as it gets, and some will always be dealt a better hand...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe you could just start... looking for some treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: Huh? How's that going to work? No compass, no guide, no trusty weapon close at hand... If I set off like this, I'd be doing nothing more than going for a long walk.

dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: Before I leave, I need to be fully prepared! That's why I need to spend more time around experienced old hands, learning everything I can.
